title: Button theme_override content_margin not working
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.4.1 stable - AMD 7900XTX

### Issue description

Getting an error when trying to tween content_margin on a button.  Not sure if it is my syntax but I have tried everything and asked Reddit.

```
E 0:00:01:105   new_custom_pause_button.gd:18 @ _on_focus_entered(): Type mismatch between initial and final value: Object and float
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed. Returning: false
  <C++ Source>  scene/animation/tween.cpp:86 @ _validate_type_match()
  <Stack Trace> new_custom_pause_button.gd:18 @ _on_focus_entered()
```

Related code in the MRP
```
tween.tween_property(self, "theme_override_styles/focus/content_margin_left", 3.0, 0.03)
tween.tween_property(self, "theme_override_styles/focus/content_margin_right", 3.0, 0.03)
tween.tween_property(self, "theme_override_styles/focus/content_margin_top", 1.0, 0.03)
tween.tween_property(self, "theme_override_styles/focus/content_margin_bottom", 1.0, 0.03)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Open the pause_menu.tscn and start it, then focus or hover a button to see the error show up in the debugger.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[GitHub link to MRP](https://github.com/jermjar/mrp-content-margins-theme-override)
